description.value: Ocean Palace is a long-established Chinese restaurant in the heart of Tsawwassen, serving authentic dishes for over 28 years with an emphasis on fresh ingredients and high standards. The extensive menu spans seafood, pork, poultry, beef, and vegetarian options, with popular items including special fried rice, chicken chow mein, and ginger beef. No-MSG preparation is available on request, and dinner combo packages cater to groups of varying sizes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Ocean Palace is an active Chinese restaurant at Unit 109 - 1077 56 Street, Delta, BC, matching the OSM address and phone number. The website explicitly promotes takeout ordering and lists a 'Vegetarian Delights & Vegetables' menu section plus Vegetarian Egg Rolls, confirming those amenities. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant with an active website confirming current hours and menu. A useful dining stop for touring cyclists on the Tsawwassen peninsula.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website lists email info@oceanpalace.ca not present in OSM tags. No MSG available upon request; food allergy notifications accepted by staff prior to ordering.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a dedicated 'Vegetarian Delights & Vegetables' section and Vegetarian Egg Rolls are listed as a menu item
